name: – § 2 – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 2.Welcomes the Commission’s proposal for an updated Council recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments; considers the rise in the use of HTPs, e-cigarettes and other aerosol emitting products in public indoor spaces to be a risk factor to public health; considers that an impact assessment should have been conducted prior to the proposal to assess the risks to public health of new and emerging products, including the impact on the hotel, restaurant and catering sectors;
